channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Schools gain autonomy over attire and activities in hot weather
item.description: Education Minister Fadhlina Sidek says schools can decide on uniforms and activities using health and weather guidelines to ensure student safety

item.title: MOE gears up for influx of six-year-olds in Year One
item.description: The Education Ministry is preparing for a significant surge in Year One enrolment from six-year-olds next year, with online registration opening this month

item.title: Malaysia and India commit to deepening strategic partnership
item.description: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim and his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi reaffirm their commitment to advancing a comprehensive strategic partnership across trade, tech and tourism.

item.title: Anwar greenlights new Indian consulate in Kota Kinabalu
item.description: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim supports India's plan for a new consulate in Sabah, a move set to deepen bilateral ties and boost economic and cultural links.

item.title: India’s Thiruvalluvar Centre in Malaysia signals soft power push
item.description: India's new cultural centre in Kuala Lumpur aims to deepen ties with Malaysia and Southeast Asia through ethical teachings and diaspora engagement

item.title: Traditionalist Catholics risk schism by defying new bishops
item.description: The Society of Saint Pius X plans to ordain bishops without Vatican approval, risking excommunication and a new schism over traditional Latin mass

item.title: U Mobile strengthens presence in Sabah with aggressive next gen 5G network expansion
item.description: As part of its 5G strategy, the telco is marking the wider availability of its ULTRA5G experience in Sabah with a large-scale consumer music, food and fashion festival called CARA U Sabah ULTRA5G Fest

item.title: Ipoh students receive RM250,000 in Madani aid ahead of festive season
item.description: Over 800 students in Ipoh Barat received RM300 each from the Sumbangan Kasih MADANI fund to help with school essentials before Chinese New Year and Ramadan.

item.title: Explosion at China biotech factory kills eight
item.description: A blast at a factory in northern China has killed eight people, with the company's legal representative detained as investigations begin

item.title: Snowbound Japan votes as Thatcher fan PM eyes landslide
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi seeks a strong mandate in a snap election held under heavy snowfall, with results set to impact China relations and financial markets
